speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs whether an independent Board of Inquiry will be convened to investigate the circumstances leading to the death of the SCDF NSF firefighter who died during the firefighting operation on 8 December 2022 with a view to determine the contributing factors that led to his death and make recommendations to rectify any lapse in the firefighting operation that may be uncovered from the review.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The BOI will then also be able to consider the Police and the Coroner’s findings, in its assessment of the matter.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: I say this because to my knowledge, when it comes to deaths that are being investigated by the Committee of Inquiry set up by the Armed Forces Council under the Singapore Armed Forces Act, these things happen in tandem.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: The inquiries are not necessarily the same as well.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Essentially, it depends on the circumstances of the matter.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: In this case, we find that we are going to have the Police investigations as well as the Coroner's investigations.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: And at the end of the day, both of them are looking at the different aspects of it.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We know the Coroner's findings will reveal the how, when and where the death happened.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: And with regard to the Police investigations, there will also be further insights to it.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We think that it is better for the BOI to look at all these findings and make its assessment.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Mr Dennis Tan, you have a supplementary question?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Just a clarification for the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Can I just get the clarification that there will be a Coroner's inquiry held in public for this incident leading to the death of the NSF?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: At the same time, we will also share the findings of the BOI.
